content_data.project_title: Mobile-First Destination Discovery Campaign for Southeast Asia Markets
content_data.project_description: Comprehensive digital marketing initiative to increase brand awareness and drive mobile app engagement among millennial and Gen-Z travelers exploring Southeast Asian destinations.
content_data.timeline: 12 months with Phase 1 (months 1-4) for research and creative development, Phase 2 (months 5-8) for campaign launch and optimization, and Phase 3 (months 9-12) for scaling and performance analysis
objectives: Improve mobile booking conversion rates by 28%
deliverables: Influencer partnership program with performance tracking dashboard
Interactive mobile app features including AR destination previews
Series of 15 destination-focused video stories optimized for mobile viewing
Comprehensive mobile-first content strategy and editorial calendar
campaign_channels: Travel blog partnerships and native content
Spotify podcast sponsorships targeting travel enthusiasts
success_metrics: Brand awareness lift measured through pre and post-campaign surveys
Mobile app download volume and attribution by channel
Mobile booking conversion rate and revenue attribution
Social media reach, impressions, and engagement rate

memory_deletes.removed_item: Mobile engagement rate including session duration and screen depth
Establish strategic partnerships with 8-10 regional travel influencers
